Definition: from G1 (as a negative particle) and G4908; unintelligent; by implication, wicked:--foolish, without understanding.
BiblicalUsage: Jesus asked His disciples, are ye also yet without understanding, when they missed the point about what defiles a man. Paul says the hearts of men were darkened because they became vain in their imaginations, and he lists the foolish and the without understanding among the marks of a mind given over.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe understanding is not a matter of cleverness, it is a matter of a heart willing to hear. The disciples learned it slowly and so do I, and I hold that Christ is patient with slow learners who keep listening.
